artworks.label: Painted ceiling decoration over the whole gallery vault (HWY XXXII:A.b.03)
artworks.note: The museum's 1930 catalogue text places it in the gallery ('Galleriet'); signed NILS ASPLUND 1905. In copyright until the end of 2028.

artworks.label: Dutch, Flemish and other paintings hung frame to frame on every wall (many dozens)
artworks.note: Not individually identified against the museum's catalogue (the collection's location data is not searchable by room).

unusable_reason: The painted ceiling over the whole gallery vault is by Nils Asplund (1905; he died in 1958, so it is in copyright until the end of 2028), and the paintings hung frame to frame on every wall (many dozens) have not been identified one by one. Masking the ceiling and every unidentified painting would leave no room to show.
